npcs.name: Mags
npcs.greeting: What'll it be? First round's not free, but it's cheap.

rumors.text: A temple sank off the southern shore, down the road past the river. Folk say it glows at night.
The Keep's warden is iron through and through. Don't bother hitting it with sticks.
Bats in the Keep carry off your coin. Or was it the thieves? One of them does.

npcs.name: Oswin
npcs.greeting: Everything has a price. Most things have two: mine, and yours.

rumors.text: Traveling merchants vanish in the dungeons. Free one and we all eat better: better stock for every stall.
Pearls from the Sunken Temple fetch twenty gold at my stall. Bring me pearls.

npcs.name: Bryn
npcs.greeting: Looking for blades? The better your name in this bar, the better the folk who'll follow you.

rumors.text: There's a wide wood east of the river, thick round the Keep. The road cuts north through it.
The mountains to the west go on forever. Nobody's come back over them.

npcs.name: Hollis
npcs.greeting: Rooms upstairs, quiet as the grave. Friends of yours waiting up there too.

rumors.text: A lake lies north of here, past the hills. Clean water, if you can stand the frogs.
The temple's doors stay shut until someone beats the Keep. Some old pact.

npcs.name: Lucky Fen
npcs.greeting: Fancy a game of Bones? Two dice each, high roll takes the pot.

rumors.text: There's a dragon's hoard under the hills east of the Keep. Swear on my dice.
Never bet against a six. Unless I'm rolling it.

npcs.name: Craven the Cowherder
npcs.greeting: Run away, I always say! Live to herd another day. The bravest thing a body can do is know when to leg it.

rumors.text: Them toll posts on the roads? Half of 'em aren't guards at all. Bandits, in borrowed helms. Look 'em in the eye.
There's something big under one of the bridges. Heard it eat a cow. My cow.

npcs.name: Old Dunstan
npcs.greeting: Eh? Oh, adventurers. Mind the bridge, it creaks.

rumors.text: Two bridges span the river: one on the east road, one on the south. The rest is swimming.
When I was young the clouds didn't cover half the world. Or my eyes were better.

menu.name: Hearth Stew
menu.text: An extra die on your next Rest roll.

menu.name: Hunter's Pie
menu.text: An extra die and +2 on your next Rest roll.

menu.name: Dragon's Breath
menu.text: Two extra dice on your next Rest roll.
